Eve (growth): Quick checklist for today's post-webinar tidy: ensure redirects, JSON-LD, internal anchors, and noindex on old thank-you variants. 24-48h watch.

Luis (seo): Agreed. My priorities: 1) 301 legacy event promos -> canonical landing 2) embed Event + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on the landing only 3) anchor map from pillar pages (benchmarks, pricing, docs) 4) run link equity snapshot pre/post.

Priya K.: I'll update the header CTA and three blog CTAs to point to /webinar-may26. Also will add a contextual link in the benchmarks page with keyword "inference latency benchmarks".

Jordan (eng): Need exact legacy paths to configure redirects and decide on query preservation rules. Also confirm whether shortlink /go/webinar should be 301 or 302 for now.

Eve (growth): Legacy paths: /events/inference-live, /promo/webinar-preview-2026, /thank-you/webinar-v1 and shortlink /go/webinar. Keep utm_source + utm_campaign; strip session_id and legacy_ref. Set /go/webinar as 302 for 72h then flip to 301.

Jordan (eng): Draft nginx rule for team: ```location = /events/inference-live { return 301 https://redwood.inference/webinar-may26?$query_string; } rewrite ^/promo/webinar-preview-2026(.*)$ /webinar-may26$1 permanent; location = /go/webinar { return 302 https://redwood.inference/webinar-may26; }``` Will add param whitelist logic in the PR.

redirect-bot: Deployed redirect rules to staging at 2026-05-12T08:00:00Z.

Luis (seo): JSON-LD snippet (landing only): {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving at Scale: Redwood Inference Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar-may26","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}} — include BreadcrumbList too.

Priya K.: Anchor mapping: /benchmarks -> "inference benchmarks"; /optimize -> "cost optimization"; /docs/canaries -> "canary deploys for models". I'll drop the CSV in the content drive.

Eve (growth): QA checklist after staging deploy: run crawl to verify 301s, check canonical tag on new page (self-referential), test structured data, confirm noindex on old thank-you pages, verify GA/UTM capture on lead form.

Jordan (eng): Eng will include rollback instructions: comment redirect block + reload + Fastly purge. Tagging eng-oncall for 48h monitor.

Luis (seo): Also recommend a short A/B test: CTA text "Watch: Serving at Scale" vs "See latency & cost benchmarks". Track CTR and form conversion for 72h.

Eve (growth): Owners: redirects=Jordan, anchors=Priya, schema validation=Luis, monitoring=eng-oncall. We'll post a summary once staging looks green. :rocket:
